notes.title: [Playism News] Angels of Death Out Now!
notes.content:
To all fans of 2D Horror Adventure games, today Playism has released "Angels of Death" on Playism and Steam! 

http://store.steampowered.com/app/537110/

From the creator of the famous horror game "Kirisame ga furu mori" (Forest of Drizzling Rain), comes "Angels of Death" which was released in the Den-fami Nico Game Magazine and is now available worldwide! 
"Angels of Death" is a psycho horror adventure game, which consists of four episodes. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27040821/845b964cb8d9038287c1684734feeaf126fd4806.jpg[/img]

When Ray woke, she was in a concrete room with no memory. After leaving the room, she explored the building, searching for an exit. But she eventually crossed paths with Zack, a murderer whose face is bandaged and bears a resemblance to the Grim Reaper. 

[quote]"Please – kill me." 
"If you help me get outta here, then I'll kill you." [/quote]

The two formed a peculiar bond through their strange "promise" and started to search for an exit to the sealed building together. 
What kind of hell have they found themselves in? For what purpose are they imprisoned? What does fate have in store for them? 

You can get Angels of Death on [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/537110/]Steam[/url] and [url=http://playism-games.com/game/307/angels-of-death]Playism![/url]

[h1]We hope you enjoy this tragically beautiful story about a murderer who wants to kill and a girl who wishes to be killed. [/h1]
